Replace every one of the four views with a real photograph of the real-world object this model stands for: a medieval alchemist's observatory: a workshop of cream limestone blocks in a dark oak frame, steep blue slate roof, stone chimney, arched stone doorway with an oak plank door, iron lantern, wooden table with a star chart; a round tower of pale plaster with grey stone bands, an arched amber-glass window, a blue-tiled dome with brass ribs and a large oak telescope with brass rings and a blue lens, a blue banner with a white diamond emblem, an armillary sphere, blue flasks, green shrubs. Keep exactly the same design as <image1>: the same parts in the same places, the same colour scheme, the same pose, and in each of the four views the same camera angle and the same side of the object. Each photograph shows the whole object, centred, cut out on a plain flat light grey background, with no ground beneath it, no base, platform or patch of grass, no shadow on the ground, no text, no labels and no lines or frames between the four views.
